summary: Fees were raised by plaintiff-side counsel in the opening public term sheet and were negotiated alongside class relief before any settlement was reached. Whitcombe Reyes’ private reasoning considered its own fee recovery and investment when evaluating settlement terms. The transcript does not clearly show a tradeoff of class relief for fees, defense exploitation of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
